president.note: The Clerk prints the presidential vote by party; the candidates' names are the FEC's. Its 'Write-in' line is the votes for declared write-in candidates, whom the FEC names one by one. Statewide and district figures only: the towns' figures are in the Secretary of State's 2020 workbooks, which could not be read. The Clerk's figures are checked against the FEC's (the contest's totals). The two compilations differ: Joseph R. Biden: Clerk 424,921, FEC 424,937; Donald J. Trump: Clerk 365,654, FEC 365,660; Jo Jorgensen: Clerk 13,235, FEC 13,236. Neither is the State's own record, which could not be read.
